dcterms:description: A regression task where the target function is defined as y(x) = Asin(ωx + b) + (ε), with parameters amplitude A, phase b, frequency ω, and noise ε sampled from a normal distribution.
dcterms:title: Sinusoidal Regression Task

dcterms:description: A regression task modeling the temperature u(x, t) at each point of a 1-dimensional rod over time after applying a constant point heat source.
dcterms:title: 1D Heat Equation Task

dcterms:title: 2D Gaussian Task
